author: Krassimir Kossev
releaseNotes:
0.1.6 2026-05-06 - initial Hubitat Package Manager release of the Aqara P100 Multi-State Sensor (DWZTCGQ11LM) driver. Supports both operating modes: object mode (movement, vibration, orientation, triple-tap and fall events, device posture) and door/window mode (contact open/closed). Battery level is derived from the reported battery voltage. Includes the Aqara registration handshake, Time cluster (0x000A) replies and factory-reset prevention. This driver is work-in-progress - please report any issues.
0.1.5 2026-05-03 - a forced Time cluster reply is sent after every FCC0 attr 0x00DF diagnostic heartbeat
0.1.4 2026-05-01 - more aqaraBlackMagic(); added Time cluster (0x000A) forced response; added ZDO handlers for End_Device_Timeout_Req (0x0036), Node_Desc_req (0x0002), Mgmt_Rtg_rsp (0x8032); added FCC0 attr 0x00FF handler for the device registration-response report
0.1.3 2026-04-29 - preventDeviceReset implementation
0.1.2 2026-04-28 - bug fixes
0.1.1 2026-04-19 - corrected fingerprint; bug fixes (tnx @rad1 for testing and feedback)
0.1.0 2026-04-18 - initial version
